name: Encrypted Tablet
summary: In the Valley of Trials, Gornek gives a coded summons to aspiring rogues. It sends them to Rwag in the Den, where rogue instruction meets the Shattered Hand.

sections.title: A Coded Summons
sections.body: Gornek gives an Encrypted Tablet to each initiate who proves their mettle against the local wildlife. Its message is written in cipher, a fitting test and precaution for those trained in stealth, poison, and subterfuge. The summons directs the recruit into the Den to meet Rwag, who trains the Horde’s rogues, thieves, and cutpurses.

sections.title: The Shadow of the Hand
sections.body: Inside the Den, initiates find Rwag, an agent aligned with the Shattered Hand. He tells new rogues the guild will not dictate their every breath, but the Hand holds him accountable if an apprentice fails to perform. The fledgling Horde is surrounded by foes and relies heavily on silent scouts and agile cutpurses to gather intelligence and eliminate threats from the shadows.

faq.q: What is the purpose of the Encrypted Tablet?
faq.answer: The Encrypted Tablet summons novice rogues from the Valley of Trials to meet their trainer, Rwag, inside the Den.

faq.q: Who delivers the tablet to the player?
faq.answer: Gornek, who oversees trials in the valley, gives you the tablet after you complete your first combat trial by killing Mottled Boars.
Rwag is deep inside the Den, the cavern complex along the northern cliffside of the Valley of Trials.

faq.q: What is 'the Hand' mentioned by Rwag?
faq.answer: Rwag means the Shattered Hand, a covert network and guild of assassins, spies, and rogues serving Warchief Thrall’s Horde.

faq.q: Why is the tablet written in an encrypted cipher?
faq.answer: The cipher hides sensitive rogue business and the identities of their handlers from prying eyes. It also tests whether an initiate can handle discreet messages.

faq.q: Can any class undertake this quest?
faq.answer: No. Only troll rogues beginning their journey in the Valley of Trials receive the Encrypted Tablet.

angles.text: As a rogue, you meet your first mentor, Rwag, through this tablet and encounter the Shattered Hand’s reach in Durotar.
As an orc, you come from a culture that honors open battlefield combat, while orc rogues serve the modern Horde as scouts and infiltrators.
As a troll, you bring jungle tracking instincts to the bladecraft taught by mentors in the Den, establishing your quiet utility among your orc allies.
